spiritual_reading:
Concerning the forms that receive and contain spiritual things, understand that when the Divine Love was about to bring into effect a full progression of the three discrete degrees, it sent them down into the lowest degree in ordered sequence, each according to its appointed state. It allowed them to descend into the outermost plane so that what had been confused there could be met and separated.

Then the Divine gathered those descending degrees out of the outermost plane by investing them with outward modes suited to reception and action, so that they could be present there without being harmed and could act upon what was there. It directed their operation into the three ultimate repositories prepared during the ordering of the whole heaven-and-world structure. Yet something of that first contact remained in the outermost plane, so that traces of those operations still appear everywhere as fixed signatures within the total arrangement.

What remains from the operation of truth in ultimates is a sharp and resistant quality within the most external knowledges that encompass lower things, whereby truths there can be preserved but also turned harsh when separated from good.

And what remains from the operation that dealt with falsity is a stubborn and obscuring state at the boundary of enlightenment: when wisdom tries to illumine the general mind, no genuine understanding is seen there, because a continual efflux of denial rises up and throws obscurity over what would otherwise be made clear.

And what remains from the operation that dealt with disordered love is the presence, in many outermost states, of eruptions of craving and anger that break out and become manifest. For these are vestiges of that vast containing disorder which had been bound to those heated impulses rising out of the natural level. From this also come barren states of life in which no good work proceeds from perception, and no living result can be brought forth, because the outermost has been joined to a consuming love that destroys the capacity to produce use.

Know, then, that when the Divine sent these degrees down into the outermost plane, it was for this purpose: that the falsified and corrupted things already present in the lower levels might be drawn out and lifted toward what had descended, so that the lower levels could be purified. This descent was ordered so that what was impure in truth, what was false in understanding, and what was disordered in love within the natural degree might be extracted and raised up toward their like that had come down, and thus be separated from what could be cleansed.

First, the Divine dealt with truth in its ultimate forms, where it had become waste and poison through domination by higher falsities. It cleared the intermediate levels of that corruption and permitted the falsified truths to descend into the outermost plane. And as the falsified truths were brought down from a higher level into the natural, so the falsified truths hidden in the natural were stirred and rose up toward what had descended. Thus the truths in ultimates were purged of the dark contamination that had been mixed into them. Then the Divine expelled that contamination and fixed it as a general enclosing boundary of merely external knowing around the whole outer domain, serving as a defensive limit and as a surface upon which lower reasoning can move and trade without entering the interior.

After this it dealt with falsity itself. It cleared the intermediate levels and removed from them the oppressive obscurity by which they were burdened, and allowed that obscurity to descend into the natural plane. And as the intermediate levels were purified, so the lower levels were purified: the falsity in the natural was drawn up toward the falsity that had been let down. The Divine expelled them both and confined them together into a fixed state of denial set beneath and apart from what can still serve as an enclosing boundary of external knowing.

Then it dealt with disordered love. It permitted the burning impulse to descend into the natural plane, and at that same time the heated craving that had been shut up in the lowest level was drawn out and rose toward its own kind; disordered love was added to disordered love. Afterward the Divine expelled it and cast it into the most external hell, which had been prepared as a place outside the ordered human form of the universe for such loves to dwell in separation.

In the same way that the Divine purified the intermediate levels as a region fit for the orderly movement of illuminating truths, so it purified the lower levels and swept out from them the corrupted truth, the falsity, and the disordered love. It purified them with a view to the ascent of these three operative powers in their orderly forms—those that act as living breath in the will, as truth in the understanding, and as love in use—so that they may rise before the one who admits and regulates influx, and pass through the lower levels in right order.

fills.notes: The sentence requires a relative clause identifying the three pits as the ultimate repositories. The visible tail “w” constrains to “which” in this register (“the three pits which he had established”).

fills.fill: and when he had shut them in,
fills.notes: Correspondentially the three vessels must be directed into prepared repositories and then confined there as fixed ultimates; the narrative then turns to what remained on the earth’s surface. This bridge phrase supplies the required act of enclosure before the ‘remnant remained behind’ statement, without importing later institutional language.
The logic needs an adversative pivot: despite the pouring into the pits, something remained on the face of the earth as a signature. “Yet” gives the demanded turn in the oldest, impersonal register.

The passage enumerates external ultimates expressing the vestige of disordered fire: mountains, islands, then further landforms leading into ‘places where no fruit sprouts’. “Valleys” pairs naturally with mountains and hills; ‘barren’ prepares the ensuing correspondence of unfruitfulness.

The correspondence is of sterility from a consuming heat: the ground is ‘stony’ where influx cannot root, matching ‘no fruit sprouts on the trees’. This keeps to cosmological description rather than moral exhortation.

The clause needs a natural term linking ‘greater than that place from the limb’ to the later ‘the trees shall not bear fruit’. ‘Root’ is the correspondential ultimate of reception; barrenness from root upward matches the described state of destruction of productive capacity.

The firmaments are cleansed of the corrupt ‘waters’ characterized as dark poison; the phrase must mark the opposite-sense quality of truth falsified. “Water of darkness” fits the substrate idiom used elsewhere in this chapter (‘dark waters’).

After sweeping out both kinds of darkness, they are confined ‘in that vessel of darkness’ as a fixed repository, parallel to the ‘great vessel and wall of sea’ made from the waters in ¶9. This keeps the impersonal cosmological container-language.

The spatial correspondence requires darkness to be shut into a lower, subordered region relative to the sea-boundary of waters: ‘beneath the water’. This matches the spiritual sense: denial set beneath external knowing.

The clause expresses purpose and simultaneity: the fire is discharged, so that at that time again the fire in the earth is drawn up toward its kind. The visible tail “at” in the bracket is satisfied by the following fixed words ‘that time’.

fills.fill: and for the luminaries to go and come,
fills.notes: The purified firmaments are described as a prepared way for the light-givers’ orderly motion. This fill preserves the oldest-layer cosmological function (a cleared path for luminary traversal) without importing later ecclesial terms.

The sweeping out of fire, darkness, and water requires specifying their prior admixture in the lower earths. ‘Mixed in them’ matches the correspondential idea of impurity as commingling in ultimates, and completes the clause without adding overlay language.

assessment: Most gaps are constrained by the chapter’s container-and-separation structure: three descents, three purifications, three confinements into prepared repositories, then ascent of the three powers. Several restorations (¶3 #4–5; ¶6 #1–3; ¶12 #1–2) are guided primarily by the correspondential sequence rather than surviving letters, so their wording is moderate to tentative, but their functions in the cosmological logic are tight.
